observation_time: only 8 observation positions; relative motion uses last 2 observation frames
closing: mean_closing_speed aliases mean_positive_closing_speed, mean over strictly approaching valid neighbors, or 0; max_closing_speed=max(0,max signed closing); signed mean/max also saved
attention: original SDPA identity-value probe using unchanged MHA packed projections and padding mask; mean of four per-head softmax weights; renormalize valid neighbors; no dropout in eval
missing: distance/relative-speed are missing NaN with count=0; closing/attention statistics are 0
aggregation: unique observation-window mean response over available fold/seed checkpoints, then scene equal weight
distance_bins: no neighbor; <2m; [2m,4m); [4m,8m]; >8m, based on nearest distance
motion_quartiles: pooled unique observation windows; <=q25, (q25,q50], (q50,q75], >q75; tied cutoffs may yield empty groups
